newsitem.title: USA: IES Iowa nuke seen back to 100 pct on wknd.
newsitem.headline: IES Iowa nuke seen back to 100 pct on wknd.

text.p: IES Utilities' 538 megawatt Duane Arnold nuclear power unit is still expected to return to full power this weekend despite problems with a feedwater pump late Wednesday, the company said Thursday.

"Everything is back to normal with the feedwater pump. Right now we're expecting to be back to 100 percent late this weekend," said company spokesman Tom Petersen, noting the unit is holding at 50 percent for routine testing.
The unit, in Palo, Iowa, was shut October 11 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
IES Utilities is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
